schema.description:
Body of POST /v1/branch/create.

Spec-only today: the handler parses the raw body by hand so a missing
field keeps returning the documented 400, not Pydantic's 422. Keep the
fields in sync with the hand parsing below.

service_type.description: Service to branch. For Postgres branches this is `postgres` — not the connector type `postgresql`.
service_type.title: Service Type

schema.title: BranchCreateRequest

202.description: Create accepted. Poll `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}` for the branch details. Idempotent replays carry an `X-Idempotency-Replay: true` response header.

400.description: A required field is missing, or the branch name or idempotency key is invalid.

409.description: This create is already in flight, or the idempotency key was reused for a different request.

422.description: The connector's engine isn't ready to branch.
